content:
greg: flagging a reconciliation anomaly: daily job shows 42 Stripe refunds not matched to NetSuite credit memos. looked into DLQ.

olivia: any pattern? same event type?

greg: all are refund.created events around 2026-05-10T02:00Z. DLQ shows they were initially delivered but consumer returned 500 for a subset. replayer later replayed them, but NetSuite ended up with duplicate credit memos for some refunds and some invoices stayed open.

tanvi: do we keep original headers in DLQ? that might explain duplicates if idempotency keys changed.

greg: DLQ payloads currently store body + minimal metadata; original Idempotency-Key and Stripe-Signature were not persisted. replayer generated a new idempotency key when replaying, which caused NetSuite integration to treat the replay as a new request.

kevin: confirmed in logs:
```
2026-05-10T02:03:11Z POST /webhook evt=evt_r1 status=500 idempotency="-"
2026-05-10T08:12:45Z replayer POST /webhook evt=evt_r1 status=200 idempotency="replayer-abc123"
```

billing-bot: scan complete: 42 affected refunds, 6 duplicate credit memos created, duplicate amount total $3,840. Created ticket FIN-2026-REF-092.

olivia: immediate remediation suggestions?

tanvi: stop automatic replayer runs until we can replay with original headers. add a backfill that uses stored raw HTTP with original Idempotency-Key.

greg: also add a consumer-side guard: if stripe_refund_id already has a mapped credit memo, skip creation and log. recon rule should use stripe_refund_id as canonical mapping.

kevin: I'll pause the scheduled replayer and implement header-preserve option. also add a reconciliation script to consolidate duplicates and apply remaining credit memos to open invoices.

tanvi: finance constraint: auto consolidate only if consolidated amount < $1,000 and duplicates <=2; anything above needs manual review.

olivia: runbook items:
- persist original headers in DLQ (assign eng-ops)
- change replayer to replay raw request including Idempotency-Key and Stripe-Signature (assign eng-ops)
- add consumer idempotency check on stripe_refund_id (assign payments team)
- add daily monitor for stripe refunds vs netsuite credit memos (assign finance ops)

kevin: schedule: I'll push pause now and aim to run backfill in low-traffic window tonight (2h). will attach dry-run CSV to FIN ticket.

billing-bot: Replayer paused at 2026-05-11T09:00Z by ops.

greg: thanks everyone. please post results of dry-run before actual backfill. closing thread but keep ticket open.
